notes: The New Duplicator's stack and box selection, planting, mirroring, cutting, saving and loading as host rules on the native copy seams, with its preference defaults: anyone may use it, full trust to select (admins may select anything, public bricks too), 10,000 bricks a selection (its 1,000,000 for admins is cut to the 10,000 a copy holds here), a 64-unit box for players (its 1024 for admins is cut to 256), a 0.4 s select wait for non-admins, saving for admins only. Stack mode selects up or down, limited or not; [Light] switches to box mode, where a click boxes a brick, the brick keys move a corner, [Rotate Brick] switches corner and [Plant Brick] selects what lies in the box. A selection glows for a few seconds and is held as a ghost at once (the original showed the ghost at the first brick key); the brick keys move it, a click puts it against what was clicked, and [Plant Brick] plants what fits and says how much was blocked, floating or missing trust. /MirrorX and /MirrorY mirror it, /Cut cuts the originals away, /SaveDup and /LoadDup keep and load it by name (and load v20 duplication files). Not ported: multi-select (Ctrl+click), turning an existing selection into a box, the pivot setting, force plant, plant as, fill colour, fill wrench, supercut, fill bricks, mirroring up and down, /AllDups, /DupVersion, the overwrite warning on /SaveDup, the plant wait, the undo confirmation for big plants, and selections over 10,000 bricks.
